title: Weaver settings
description: How Weaver works in this project. A repository is supervised as soon as this file exists; the other files of `.weaver/` are optional.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, for the editor.

finish.description: How a task ends, and how long the checks may hold the agent.

skill.description: The file that tells the agent how to write the final message, relative to the repository root. Its header lists the `headings` of that message: a final message that carries them all is what tells Weaver that a task is finished. Weaver guards the file, and names it to an agent that stops with changed files and without the headings. Without a skill, every end of turn ends the task.

maxRounds.description: How many times in a row the checks may refuse the end of a turn. After that the agent may stop, its unit of work still open.

deadlineSeconds.description: How long one run of all the checks may take.

concurrency.description: How many checks run at once.
